description: This file defines the Guess class, which models a guessed word and associated feedback in a word-guessing game, including serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: Guess
classes.description: Represents a single guessed word and its feedback in the game, with methods for copying, serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Guess object with optional new word and feedback.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Guess object into a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON map into a Guess object.
